title: VMM worklists: stable semantic rows and independent revisions
summary: All VMM operational worklists must use the shared authoritative 0/1/N row model. Row position is presentation only; identity, selection and actions bind to stable server-owned semantic identities across sort/filter/page operations.
implementation_status: Required baseline for the next VMM UI increment; this article records project doctrine and does not claim Wire UI Web v0.3 already implements the complete list platform contract.
invariants: Server-authoritative collections render predictably as 0, 1 or N semantic rows.
Collection values and *Count values are separate facts.
Every row has a stable server-owned semanticRowId such as VMM-ORD-00019281; row index is never authority.
Sorting preserves selection when membership is unchanged.
Filtering or scope changes invalidate selection when the selected semantic row is no longer a member.
Paging/windowing does not change semantic row identity.
queryRevision, scopeRevision, orderRevision, selectionRevision and resultRevision are distinct.
Stale rendered contexts, forged row IDs and invalid selections fail closed.
Orders, fills, positions, synthetic contracts, funding/collateral and exceptions must all use this model.
